nodes.description: Authorization mapping (address => uint) in GemJoin tracking privileged wards.
VatLike_6 public vat: reference to the CDP engine in GemJoin.
bytes32 public ilk: collateral type identifier in GemJoin.
GemLike_3 public gem: external ERC20 collateral token in GemJoin.
uint public dec: cached decimals of the gem token in GemJoin.
uint public live: active flag of the GemJoin adapter.
Authorization mapping (address => uint) in DaiJoin tracking privileged wards.
VatLike_6 public vat: reference to the CDP engine in DaiJoin.
DSTokenLike public dai: external stablecoin token in DaiJoin.
uint public live: active flag of the DaiJoin adapter.
uint constant ONE = 10**27 used to scale wad into ray in DaiJoin.
note modifier that appends an anonymous log4 assembly event after the modified function body executes.
GemJoin.rely(address usr) external note auth: grants ward privileges by setting wards[usr]=1.
GemJoin.deny(address usr) external note auth: revokes ward privileges by setting wards[usr]=0.
GemJoin constructor initializing wards, live, vat, ilk, gem and reading gem.decimals().
GemJoin.cage() external note auth: disables the adapter by setting live=0.
GemJoin.join(address usr, uint wad): credits collateral into the Vat via vat.slip and pulls tokens with gem.transferFrom.
GemJoin.exit(address usr, uint wad): debits collateral from the Vat via vat.slip and sends tokens with gem.transfer.
DaiJoin.rely(address usr) external note auth: grants ward privileges by setting wards[usr]=1.
DaiJoin.deny(address usr) external note auth: revokes ward privileges by setting wards[usr]=0.
DaiJoin constructor initializing wards, live, vat and dai.
DaiJoin.cage() external note auth: disables the adapter by setting live=0.
internal pure mul(uint x, uint y): overflow-checked multiplication used to scale wad by ONE.
DaiJoin.join(address usr, uint wad): moves internal Dai from the adapter to the user in the Vat and burns external dai.
DaiJoin.exit(address usr, uint wad): requires live, moves internal Dai from caller to the adapter and mints external dai.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, token transfers, burning and Vat moves.
External call gem.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), wad) in GemJoin.join with a caller-supplied token contract.
External call gem.transfer(usr, wad) in GemJoin.exit with a caller-supplied token contract.
External call vat.slip(ilk, usr, int(wad)) in GemJoin.join and vat.slip(ilk, msg.sender, -int(wad)) in GemJoin.exit.
External call vat.move(...) in DaiJoin.join and DaiJoin.exit transferring internal Dai balances.
External call dai.burn(msg.sender, wad) in DaiJoin.join destroying external stablecoin.
External call dai.mint(usr, wad) in DaiJoin.exit creating external stablecoin.
Arithmetic multiplication z = x * y with overflow guard require(y == 0 || (z = x * y) / y == x) inside DaiJoin.mul.
Signed integer cast and bound checks: require(int(wad) >= 0) in join and require(wad <= 2 ** 255) in exit.
Inline assembly block in the note modifier writing calldata to memory and emitting log4(mark, 288, ...).

Parameter wad of GemJoin.exit, the collateral amount bound-checked, negated and transferred out.

Parameter usr of DaiJoin.deny, the address stripped of ward privileges.
Constructor parameter vat_ assigned to DaiJoin.vat.
Constructor parameter dai_ assigned to DaiJoin.dai.
Parameter usr of DaiJoin.join, the Vat account receiving internal Dai.
Parameter wad of DaiJoin.join, scaled by ONE and burned from the caller.

Parameter x (multiplicand) of the internal mul function.
Parameter y (multiplier) of the internal mul function.
Local variable z holding the result of the overflow-checked multiplication in mul.

External view call gem.decimals() executed in the GemJoin constructor to populate dec.
